label: Certiorari granted
caption: FCC, ET AL. V. CONSUMERS' RESEARCH, ET AL.
text: The petitions for writs of certiorari are granted. The cases are consolidated, and a total of one hour is allotted for oral argument. In addition to the questions presented by the petitions, the parties are directed to brief and argue the following question: Whether this case is moot in light of the challengers' failure to seek preliminary relief before the Fifth Circuit.
